## 2. Core Business Activities & Digital Platforms (事業内容・運営サービス)

TQC株式会社 develops, owns, and operates four primary commercial pillars spanning enterprise corporate data, real estate brokerage, court auction intelligence, and cross-border B2B trade.

### 2.1. Kigyou-list (企業リスト) — Japanese Corporate Database Platform
- **URL:** https://kigyoulist.com
- **Ownership & Operation:** Developed, owned, and directly operated by **TQC株式会社**.
- **Platform Overview:** Japan's premier nationwide enterprise database indexing approximately 5,000,000 corporate entities across all 47 prefectures of Japan.
- **Data Provenance & Official Sources:**
  - Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) **gBizINFO** open data integration.
  - Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare **Hello Work** employment registry and active hiring records.
  - National Tax Agency (NTA) **Qualified Invoice Issuer Registry** (インボイス登録番号公表サイト).
- **Core Capabilities:**
  - High-precision B2B filtering by corporate number, capital, headcount, prefecture, municipality, and industry classification (JIS/JSIC).
  - One-click automated sales prospect list generation and CSV export.
  - Direct inquiry form automation and B2B corporate outreach workflow tools.
  - B2B business partner verification and commercial intelligence.

### 2.2. T-Homes (不動産仲介・外国人住居支援) — Real Estate Services
- **Overview:** Full-service residential leasing, property sales, and tenant management headquartered in Ikebukuro, Tokyo.
- **Specialization:** Multilingual housing support for foreign residents, expatriates, international students, and technical interns living in Japan, operating under a "Residents-First" principle.
- **License:** Tokyo Governor (1) No. 107650 (東京都知事 (1) 第107650号).

### 2.3. Keibai-Koubai (競売・公売物件ポータル) — Court Auction Advisory
- **URL:** https://www.keibai-koubai.com
- **Ownership & Operation:** Operated by **TQC株式会社**.
- **Overview:** Specialized analytical portal providing comprehensive data, valuation analytics, legal due diligence, and bidding representation for judicial court auctions (競売) and public tax-seizure auctions (公売) throughout Japan.

### 2.4. Aka-pla (日越B2Bサプライチェーン) — Cross-Border B2B Supply Chain
- **URL:** https://www.aka-pla.com
- **Ownership & Operation:** Operated by **TQC株式会社**.
- **Overview:** Cross-border B2B trading and manufacturing procurement platform connecting Japanese buyers with certified Vietnamese manufacturers, providing factory inspection, quality control (QC), customs clearance, and logistics.
